email_body:
Dear ERGaR team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications & Policy Internship in Brussels. With a background in digital marketing, SEO and WordPress, I can contribute immediately to your communications work while learning how a European trade association operates.

In my current roles, I create content, manage WordPress sites and use Canva for visuals. I have built and optimized websites, including a multi-page site for a Belgian chess champion, and I regularly publish blog posts and manage CMS content. I also hold a HubSpot Content Marketing certification, which gives me a foundation for email campaigns and contact management. I am fluent in English and eager to support the European Biomethane Trading Conference and your policy monitoring activities.

I am proactive, organized and comfortable juggling different tasks. I would welcome the chance to bring my communications skills to your small, international team and to learn more about renewable energy policy.

Thank you for your consideration.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear ERGaR team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications & Policy Internship at ERGaR. As a digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, WordPress and Canva, I am eager to contribute to your communications and event activities while learning how a European trade association operates.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I build and maintain WordPress websites, write and publish blog content, and create visual materials using Canva. For example, I designed and run baverok.com and built mirook.com, a multi-page site for a Belgian youth chess champion, where I implemented structured data and ran technical SEO audits. I also manage CMS content for client sites, including a pharmacists' association site with around 600 member profile pages. These experiences have strengthened my organizational skills and attention to detail, which I would apply to supporting the European Biomethane Trading Conference and member meetings.

I hold a HubSpot Content Marketing certification, which has given me a foundation in email campaigns and contact management. I am fluent in English and comfortable using AI tools for research and content. While my background is in digital marketing rather than EU policy, I am a quick learner with a strong interest in renewable energy and sustainability, and I am keen to develop my knowledge of EU energy policy.

I am proactive, flexible and enjoy managing varied tasks. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my communications skills to your small, international team and to contribute to ERGaR's work promoting renewable gas.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Content creation and CMS management: writes and publishes SEO blog posts, manages WordPress sites (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math), and creates visuals with Canva.
• Website management: builds and maintains WordPress websites, including a multi-page site with structured data and a pharmacists' association site with ~600 member profiles.
• Email marketing foundation: HubSpot Content Marketing certification, supporting email campaigns and contact management.
• Event and organizational support: experience managing multiple client projects, building consistent layouts, and coordinating content for websites.
• Language and international team fit: fluent English, native Turkish, basic Dutch; experience working remotely with international clients.
